rule: This title map is complete enough to drive execution. Do not regenerate or renumber it on dot; continue from it.

sections.title: Authority and preservation
items: A01 Reincarnate current Prometeo authority before editing coordination runtime
A02 Preserve Part 3 Current/Human Accepted/Served distinctions
A03 Preserve V53 visible authority and V23 physics authority
A04 Preserve P4 Capture as separate active candidate workstream
A05 Preserve Calendar LAB work and existing external product work
A06 Define Agent Network as coordination only, never product authority

sections.title: One-command human experience
items: B01 Make the legacy bootstrap message one short line
B02 Keep Prometeo as RESYNC + RECOVER + CONTINUE
B03 Keep dot as CONTINUE CURRENT FRONTIER
B04 Keep the visible Prometeo Seal as human attestation
B05 Define no-seal recovery behavior
B06 Define the unavoidable one-time bootstrap boundary for already-open unaware chats

sections.title: Cheap global freshness check
items: C01 Create public EPOCH.json
C02 Make epoch tiny enough to read before material work
C03 Define semantic epoch hash/revision inputs
C04 Store epoch_seen in compiled packets/worker state
C05 Same epoch means continue without coordination reads
C06 New epoch means fetch only the refreshed compiled packet

sections.title: Worker identity and status
items: D01 Define disposable worker_instance_id
D02 Create one worker status file per chat/agent instance
D03 Ensure workers never edit one shared mutable status file
D04 Define minimal status fields
D05 Update status only on material frontier/change, not heartbeat loops
D06 Support workers operating on external repositories

sections.title: Workstream discovery and registration
items: E01 Keep Catalog surface routing before repository archaeology
E02 Auto-detect existing active workstream when possible
E03 Use GENERAL read-only fallback when no workstream exists
E04 Scaffold a scoped workstream only when material writes begin
E05 Stop requiring manual NOW edits for every future workstream
E06 Generate a derived workstream index from PACK/status files

sections.title: Chat-of-chats network view
items: F01 Create compiled NETWORK.json
F02 Show who is doing what without exposing private conversation content
F03 Include repo branch head write scope mode frontier and last useful delta
F04 Include dependencies needs impacts and convergence candidates
F05 Include stale/unknown state without pretending inactivity
F06 Keep NETWORK derived and read-only for agents

sections.title: Impact and dependency semantics
items: G01 Define NEEDS
G02 Define PROVIDES/OUTPUTS
G03 Define IMPACTS
G04 Define DEPENDS_ON
G05 Define candidate shared owner for reusable discoveries
G06 Match satisfied needs automatically where evidence is sufficient

sections.title: Convergence and conflict detection
items: H01 Detect overlapping write scopes
H02 Detect one workstream changing a dependency consumed by another
H03 Detect two workstreams independently inventing the same shared capability
H04 Emit convergence candidates rather than global locks
H05 Distinguish hard collision from soft informational convergence
H06 Route convergence only to affected workers

sections.title: Delta compilation
items: I01 Preserve DELTA_FEED as global semantic discoveries only
I02 Auto-synthesize candidate deltas from worker status and Git activity
I03 Keep local implementation detail in worker return/Git history
I04 Filter deltas by workstream topics/dependencies/impacts
I05 Deliver only unseen relevant deltas to each compiled packet
I06 Prevent stale RETURN from causing full-project reconstruction

sections.title: Compiled Work Packet v3
items: J01 Upgrade compiler to consume EPOCH NETWORK worker status and Git activity
J02 Include current human intent and already-decided constraints
J03 Include last useful local delta and saved execution frontier
J04 Include only relevant cross-chat changes
J05 Include conditional read graph rather than raw archaeology
J06 Preserve FAST DEEP EXHAUSTIVE CONTINUE selection

sections.title: Execution behavior
items: K01 FAST means execute critique repair
K02 DEEP means context first complete meaningful title map develop execute critique repair
K03 EXHAUSTIVE freezes the full map once and forbids filler
K04 CONTINUE resumes without replanning
K05 Checks are evidence not progress
K06 Same failed strategy twice triggers strategy change rather than more checks

sections.title: Recovery and legacy chats
items: L01 Preserve existing chat work before bootstrap
L02 Recover from conversation plus Git delta
L03 Treat RETURN as accelerator not authority
L04 Create worker/workstream registration after recovery when writes continue
L05 Never ask the human to manually summarize recoverable context
L06 Make bootstrap idempotent so repeated Prometeo is safe

sections.title: Privacy and authority boundaries
items: M01 Never compile LOCAL transcripts or Patent payloads into public Network
M02 Keep PROJECT/private metadata separated from public coordination metadata
M03 Never let Network grant Current/Human Accepted/Served authority
M04 Preserve declassification requirements for Capture/Patent
M05 Avoid credentials and secrets in worker status
M06 Make public status descriptions intentionally compact and non-sensitive

sections.title: Publication and validation
items: N01 Add runtime v3 compiler outputs without disturbing product Pages
N02 Publish stable short bootstrap EPOCH NETWORK manifest and packets
N03 Keep gh-pages writes limited to derived coordination artifacts
N04 Test routing with registered and unregistered surfaces
N05 Test two parallel workers with disjoint scopes and one convergence event
N06 Test stale/missing RETURN recovery and finish with durable next frontier
